package.name: navpromini_launch_manager
package.description: Relocated from nav2_mission_planner: process supervision for the mapping/ navigation launch files (LaunchWithArgs/StopLaunch/GetMapList/DeleteMap), plus rosbridge and rosapi so the Flutter app and any ROS-native client keep working independent of navpromini_sdk. Camera streaming and tf2_buffer_server were dropped in the move — nothing currently depends on either.
